_readme: Single source of truth for every casino fact the site prints. Text values may be a string or {"en":..,"ru":..,"pt":..,"es":..}. verified_at = the day a human last checked the facts on the casino itself; the build warns when it is older than 60 days. test_log entries are rendered on reviews and comparison pages: only add tests that really happened. bonus.source = 'lumenbet-api' means the build refreshes it from the live Lumenbet API (falls back to these values when the API is unreachable, e.g. from geo-blocked CI runners).
